{{Top|leg}}
'''Hovergurneys''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped hospital beds capable of transporting an injured being from place to place without injuring the patient further. Used in most [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]], they were also used in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing]].
